summary:
#487. Prior delivery checked first: NECESSARY-CONCRETE-FROM-ACTUAL-GROUNDED and NECESSARY-ROOT-CONTROLS (#553) deliver the conditional and omissions of dependence, well-foundedness and population, with relation-type, counterpart and accessibility controls; closed PR #528's branch codex/487-necessary-concrete-root was not merged and its vocabulary is superseded by Profile, so it was not revived. Its issue-comment strengthening (same witness necessary and root) is delivered here as a clause of the controls. Question: which route statement does a necessary concretum supply? Searched the paraphrases of the direct premises of the 11 root arguments: none mentions necessity or contingency, matching the blocker of ATTEMPT-WF-REVERSE-DILEMMA-553. Without bridges nothing: one model has two necessary actual roots and fails grades-have-a-maximum, something-is-moved and the first-being premise. These share no predicate with Profile, so that independence is cheap and tests only those three premises. With bridges one connection was found: via the tertia via's convergence, at modal readings of its parameters, the necessary root yields STMT-MAXIMUM-IN-BEING-IS-FIRST-BEING. Rejected as a claim of progress: that conclusion costs seven open non-logical premises for one, so no route cost falls. Finding: with two bridges covering every actual concretum in place of NecessaryBeingHasBeing and the two necessity-cause bridges, the same premise follows from mere asymmetry of the selected relation, with no root, necessity, contingency or inhabitedness premise, and a witness has a contingent maximum. So under those stronger bridges that derivation uses neither rootness nor necessity. Rejected reading: identifying Possible with accessibility as source fidelity; it is recorded as a parameter reading. Also certified: rootness is world-relative; a begins-to-exist law does not give the closing premise over a past with no first moment. Not attempted: Pruss, Oppy and Craig witnesses listed on #487; no source claim is made. Metadata audit (2026-11-09): inspected every definition/disambiguation link on b19ffd92-01bd-5c0b-9643-e7407137ea5e against frozen BruteFoundationBoundary.NecessaryConcreteAt: ∃ x, m.concrete x ∧ m.ontic.ExistsAt w x ∧ NecessaryAt m.ontic w x. Replaced c57e2682-08e6-527e-950f-0fa0a7ff11ef (NecessaryRootFork.ActualRoot) with existing 1b8baf77-84fa-5513-a138-7fa14840dd87 (CogitoConcrete.InhabitedConcreteAt). The former adds absence of actual concrete grounds, which this endpoint neither states nor consumes; Profile carrying a grounds field does not make roothood part of the proposition. The replacement defines exactly its concrete/actual witness conjuncts on the same Ontic and world; its supplied world-independent concrete predicate remains parametric, not automatically a defended esse criterion. Retained all five other links: baddf770 supplies the de-re/de-dicto quantifier distinction (this formula uses the fixed-witness de-re member of that vocabulary bundle, not its DeDicto locator as a claimed equality); e1ff44df the fixed roster, actualist existence guards and rigid identity; f8948e28 the frame/accessibility vocabulary; 38b92bb6 the exact NecessaryAt body ∀ v, access w v → ExistsAt v x; beb654a7 the Ontic signature. Retained disambiguation 7507d645: the same candidate exists actually and at all accessible worlds, not Scott essence-based NE or temporal cannot-not-be. No claim that a vocabulary container defines every component or that its unused Causes field adds causal content. No reflexivity is implicit, so an empty accessible cone leaves actual concrete existence. Existing unique-root projection explicitly forgets roothood and uniqueness; the necessary-bearer consumer drops only concreteness. Frozen Lean, statement paraphrase, all premises, source claims, allowances and proof evidence are unchanged. This is semantic metadata repair, not a new consequence, original declaration completion, premise discharge or root truth. Same-profile endpoint assembly remains separate work; no unmerged proof is imported. Validation of this metadata delta: corpus check, bundle_audit, sense/label ratchets, attribution-check and generated imports/docs pass. Explicit binding of all fourteen direct provider/consumer result IDs reports 14 bound, 0 mismatch; automatic affected selection is not relied upon as consumer coverage. Existing frozen proof/kernel/Comparator/NanoDa evidence is reused without a new proof claim; final delivered-head CI remains required. Computed frontier-diff against main 4de4ca01e10a2e6483a397eb5acab04da75d0522 reports no change (396 open reaching premises, lowest route cost 16, 284 verified support alternatives); thickness is unchanged at 575 statements, 180 derived, 53 multiply derived, 330 derivations. No independent source or metaphysical applicability check was added. Shared convention sourceRevision 625cb04ca568aebc8d45c90033e107a05e9bd2a0.

Curation pass 2, lane D (#2103, 2026-11-27). 90dbcc69 tests 56f68b40. Omit inhabitedness from the nonnecessary-root principle. The Unit candidate is absent at the sole world, actual grounding is well-founded, and no necessary concretum exists there. No candidate can witness a nonnecessary actual root. 90dbcc69 tests 82cfaf26. Omit actual grounding well-foundedness from the nonnecessary-root principle. The Nat successor grounds at true give each actual contingent candidate a predecessor in the grounding relation. No candidate is necessary or an actual root.

Curation pass 2, lane D (#2103, 2026-11-27). d492d6e9 tests 82cfaf26. Omit well-foundedness on the actual concrete population. The sole world has two actual concreta that ground each other. The other six nonlogical clauses hold, but the maximum false has the distinct simply prior bearer true. d492d6e9 tests c71c068c. Omit an actual concrete ground for each actual contingent concretum. In contingentRootProfile both candidates are present at true, but only false is present at false. The contingent root true has no ground. BeginningLawControl separately has one ungrounded individual present at every time at true and absent at false. It satisfies the ground-for-beginnings rule while failing the contingent grounding premise at true. d492d6e9 tests d29cebca. Omit the bridge from a distinct cause of necessity to actual concrete grounding. Both concrete candidates exist at the sole world. False causes the necessity of true, but the only ground edge goes from true to false. d492d6e9 tests 86efed1a. Omit the bridge from distinct simple priority to actual concrete grounding. Both concrete candidates exist at the sole world. True is simply prior to false, but the only ground edge goes from false to true. d492d6e9 tests d9fad785. Omit the premise that a maximum in a respect causes the other bearers in that respect. At the only modeled respect, false is maximal and true is in act. The cause relation is empty, so false does not cause true in that respect. d492d6e9 tests 79281639. Omit the premise that a modal necessary being is in act at esse. At the sole world both candidates are concrete and necessary, and only false is in act at esse. The distinct bearer true is simply prior to false. d492d6e9 tests 3c468121. Omit the link from a cause of a supplied necessary being's esse to a cause of its necessity. True is necessary relative to the sole world, and false causes true at esse, but the necessity-cause relation is empty. d492d6e9 retains a nonlogical witness for 52d36165. The whole-argument link to 52d36165 from #2126 was removed. NoBridgeNoSlot does not certify ExcludedMiddle over arbitrary propositions. Witness inhabitedness, actual grounding well-foundedness and contingent grounding together in NoBridgeNoSlot. The sole self-accessing world has two concrete bearers, both present and necessary, and no ground edges. Contingent grounding holds vacuously. The argument takes excluded middle explicitly. d492d6e9 retains a nonlogical witness for f53dd124. The whole-argument link to f53dd124 from #2126 was removed. AllClausesWitness does not certify ExcludedMiddle over arbitrary propositions. Witness all seven nonlogical premises in the sole self-accessing world, with both concrete bearers present and necessary. True is maximal and simply prior to false. The single edge from true to false serves as a ground and a cause at esse and of necessity. Contingent grounding holds vacuously. The argument takes excluded middle explicitly. NecessityFreeWitness supplies the nonlogical inputs of the full NecessityFreeFirstBeing conditional with a contingent maximum. That conditional derives MaximumInBeingIsFirstBeing from ActualGroundingAsymmetric, explicit excluded middle, MaximumInGenusCausesAllInGenusReading, ActualConcretaHaveBeing, EsseCauseIsActualConcreteGround and SimplyPriorIsActualConcreteGround. The full conditional has no dedicated statement or argument registration. RootNotRigid witnesses a necessary individual that is an actual root at the reading world and has an actual concrete ground at an accessible world. The separate persistence claim that such an individual remains an actual root at every accessible world has no dedicated statement registration. In maximumFirstOfNecessaryRoot, the distinct simply prior case provides an actual concretum through the prior bridge, and equality closes the other case. ActualGroundingWF alone can hold on the empty subtype. necessaryConcreteOfActualGrounded has an explicit inhabitedness premise.
blocker: The closing premise EveryContingentGroundedAt and restricted well-foundedness have no defence for any real relation; the four bridges are open; a route premise needing de re necessity was not found, so the necessary-being milestone does not lower a route cost. Whether a route should gain a necessity-consuming premise is a modelling question for the owner, not a proof gap.
